BOOK ONE · LESSON 137

A pleasant dream

美好的梦

A dialogue lesson between Brian and Julie about their dreams of winning a lot of money on the football pools. Brian says he's nearly finished the football pools and is sure they'll win something. Julie says if they win a lot of money, she wants to see the world, travel round the world, and stay at the best hotels. Brian says if they win, they'll travel round the world, stay at the best hotels, return home, and buy a big house in the country. Julie worries that if they spend all the money, they'll be poor again. The lesson introduces the use of 'if' clauses with present and past tenses, and the use of 'win' with sports and games. The workbook drills the dialogue fill-in and vocabulary opposites; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences with 'if' and present tense, and rewrites 'if' clauses in the past tense.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and then answer the question that follows. 听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

听录音，然后回答所接下来的问题。

  1. 1

    Brian

    I've nearly finished the football pools, Julie. I'm sure we'll win something this week.

    我差不多已填好足球彩票，朱莉。我肯定我们这星期会中的。

  2. 2

    Julie

    We never win anything, but what will you do if you win a lot of money?

    我们从来未中过奖，但如果你中了一大笔钱，你将干什么？

  3. 3

    Brian

    If I win a lot of money, I'll buy you a mink coat.

    如果我中了大笔钱，我就给你买一件貂皮大衣。

  4. 4

    Julie

    I don't want a mink coat! I want to see the world.

    我不想要貂皮大衣！我想看看这个世界。

  5. 5

    Brian

    All right. If we win a lot of money, we'll travel round the world and we'll stay at the best hotels. Then we'll return home and buy a big house in the country.

    好吧。如果我们中了大笔钱，我们将环游世界并住最好的旅馆。然后我们回来，在乡下买幢大房子。

  6. 6

    Julie

    But if we spend all that money, we'll be poor again. And what will we do then?

    但如果我们把钱花光了，我们又将变成穷人。那时我们将怎么办呢？

  7. 7

    Brian

    If we spend all the money, we'll try and win the football pools again!

    如果花光所有的钱，我们再来一次足球彩票！

Question: 问题。Who always wins the football pools? 谁总是中足球彩票奖？

问题：谁总是中足球彩票奖？

New words & expressions 生词和短语

football pools
n. phr. 足球彩票
win /wɪn/
v. 赢，获胜
mink coat
n. phr. 貂皮大衣
return /rɪˈtɜːn/
v. 返回

Notes on the text 课文注释

win 的用法

「赢」用于比赛、游戏、彩票等：win a match / win the football pools / win a prize.

if 条件句的时态

if 引导的条件从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时：If I win a lot of money, I'll buy you a mink coat.

Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences using 'if' and the present tense

10 sentence-rewrite items; item 1 (We may win the prize. (we/won, you/invite) → If we won the prize, we would invite you to dinner.) is the printed example.

Grammar II: Rewrite the 'if' clauses in the past tense

仿照例句用过去时改写以下句子中的 if 从句。
